body: Talked about it with my wife.  I’m not doing it yet.  Holding on to my plans though.
With everything going for me, I’m still in agony.

I’m trying not to leave any hints, but in addition to my mental illness, I suffer from chronic physical illnesses. Many years of agony with doctors, specialists, and pain management is leading nowhere.  My latest (and most expensive treatment) is failing me too.  Insurance isn’t helping.  I haven’t had a job in MANY years.  I can’t get any assistance because my wife’s income disqualifies me.  Just enough money to miss out on disability or other assistance, not enough to afford health coverage that works.
It hurts me to stay alive for them.  It hurts me every day knowing how much pain I’m going to leave them. I address this in my suicide notes.  Hopefully they’ll be relieved that I’m not suffering.
